The dish is a stainless steel mixing bowl, probably 20-25 cm across at the rim. The food is a pile of diced cooked chicken breast (or possibly tofu) mixed with sliced red onion and shredded carrot. The pile is roughly 12 cm across and a few cm deep.

Estimated volume is about 12 cm × 12 cm × 4 cm × 0.6, or roughly 350 ml. At a density of about 0.6 g/ml for diced pieces, that comes to around 200 g.

I'm treating it as mostly chicken, about 170 g, plus about 30 g of onion and carrot. Cooked chicken breast runs about 165 kcal per 100 g, so 170 g gives about 280 kcal. The vegetables add about 12 kcal.

That puts the total near 295 kcal. If it is tofu, the energy would be lower, so I'll round down to about 290 kcal.
